title: Molecular docking-guided design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of novel multitarget HDAC/ROCK inhibitors.
snippet: Histone deacetylases (HDACs) and Rho-associated coiled-coil containing protein kinases (ROCKs) play key roles in tumor progression, metastasis, and immunomodulation, particularly in aggressive malignancies such as triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC).
